content_warning: SYNTHETIC. Every entry below is fictional and was written to rehearse the discovery instrument. None of it describes the University of Iowa. No University input has been collected.

entries.task: In-editor code completion and short refactor suggestions while writing service code
outputs: suggested code accepted into a branch before review

observed_benefits.claim: boilerplate for a new endpoint takes noticeably less time to write

known_limitations: suggestions are wrong often enough that review was never relaxed
not used on the payment-adjacent module by team decision
entries.notes: Strength case: a claim with an artifact behind it.

entries.task: Generating first-draft unit test scaffolds for legacy modules that have none
outputs: a draft test file that a developer then rewrites

observed_benefits.claim: gives a starting point on modules nobody wants to touch

known_limitations: generated assertions are frequently trivial and get deleted
entries.notes: Demotion case: declared active, but the cadence is occasional.

entries.task: Writing release notes from commit history

observed_benefits.claim: release notes go out much faster than they used to

entries.notes: Gap case: stated confidently in the room, nothing behind it when asked.

entries.task: Summarising free-text responses from an internal service survey
outputs: a themes memo circulated inside the team

observed_benefits.claim: themes surface in an afternoon instead of over two days

known_limitations: summaries flatten disagreement; the team re-reads outliers by hand
entries.notes: Honest informal use: real, running, not sanctioned or integrated.

entries.task: Proposed first-line triage of service-desk tickets
known_limitations: no decision yet on how a misrouted ticket would be caught
entries.notes: Clean planned use: nothing observed, nothing claimed.

entries.task: Script generation for one-off data extracts
inputs: a description of the extract needed
outputs: a Python script used for the August extract

observed_benefits.claim: the August extract was turned around in a morning

entries.notes: Conflict case: declared not-yet-started, but output exists. Both readings kept.

entries.task: Drafting replies to routine access-request tickets for an analyst to edit and send
outputs: a draft reply placed in the ticket for human edit

observed_benefits.claim: routine replies are edited rather than written from scratch

known_limitations: not used for anything involving an exception to policy
entries.notes: Second strength case, in a different group.

entries.task: Grouping quarterly access-review exceptions so a human reviews them in batches
outputs: a grouped worksheet used in the Q2 review

observed_benefits.claim: the Q2 review was worked in batches rather than row by row

known_limitations: the grouping is re-checked by hand before any access is changed
entries.notes: Demotion case: real and evidenced, but explicitly not wired into any system.

entries.task: Something involving drafting procedure text; the respondent was not sure who does it
entries.notes: Captured honestly as UNKNOWN rather than guessed at.

entries.task: Reading long vendor release notes and pulling out changes that affect the team
outputs: a short note pasted into the team channel
known_limitations: nobody checks whether anything was missed
entries.notes: Blank-is-not-zero case: frequency and headcount unknown, use is real.
